protocol.physics: unchanged native_env.spec/Task, K80D8 10N, Direct256,10/50/200Hz, original frozen BFM/PD, deterministic mean
protocol.initial_states: Existing native standing/goal_arm5/motion_walk_task executed in real physics to source_until; no qpos offsets or history reset. Root/wrist offsets are measured consequences, not prescribed teleports. Source identity is environment metadata, never actor input.
protocol.scope: New combinations not used for 5403 selection; within known families, not claim wholly unseen training distribution. Fixed13 with no additions/removals after results.
protocol.pairing: Independent processes per frozen model, same ordered cases, seed5517 reset per case. Full source audit including integration solver/BFM/history/previous_action/lastz/force state must match exactly. Common-prefix stop/continue checked on saved real control and physics before stop.

severe.description: Any physical boundary/incomplete physical episode is a failure; other thresholds carried from RETENTION, per-condition versus BC.

promotion.cost_tolerances_reason: Predeclared practical margins: peak max(+.15m/s,+25%); p95 max(+.01m/s,+25%); final yaw +5deg. Not statistical confidence intervals or universal requirements. Report continuous deltas even when within margins.
promotion.passed_conclusion: new-condition validation passed; next decision second seed confirmation, not automatically executed
promotion.failed_conclusion: benefit limited to development conditions; candidate remains developmental, BC500 baseline maintained; report condition-specific wins too
